notes: The old blogs.darden.virginia.edu profile URL 301-redirects to the darden.virginia.edu blog URL recorded here. Official profile shows GPA 3.54 (the previously recorded 3.56 was not on the page as fetched this session). GRE published only as combined score (average and median 322, middle 80 percent 311-335), no quant/verbal split. Acceptance rate is not published on Darden's profile page; the prior 30.7 figure came from US News, which is outside this pass's allowed sources, so the field is nulled. The main darden.virginia.edu/mba/admissions/class-profile page renders stats in Flourish embeds with no inline data; the official blog profile was used instead. Employment PDF percentages: offers within 3 months 260 plus 35 of 327 (90.2 percent); acceptances within 3 months 251 plus 41 of 327 (89.3 percent).
